subject: general
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

She has been working in this organisation __since 5 years.__
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The preposition "**for**" is used to describe a period or duration of time.
 
• The phrase "**since 5 years**" is incorrect because "**since**" is used to refer to a specific starting point in time, not a duration.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**for 5 years**" to indicate the duration of time she has been working in the organization.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She has been working in this organization **for**__ 5 years."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "till"** is incorrect because "till" is used to indicate a point in time when something ends, not a duration.
 
• **Option 3: "across"** is incorrect because "across" is used to indicate movement or position from one side to another, not time.
 
• **Option 4: "No substitution"** is incorrect because the original sentence is grammatically incorrect and needs improvement.
